text:
anna: quick sync: support flagged a customer onboarding flow where a 429 during token rotation caused a duplicate charge. not widespread but high friction.
kevin: do we know if the SDK retried mid-refresh or server replayed? any logs?
anna: sanitized trace from the customer:
```
2026-03-22T11:02:12Z req=rn-42 status=429 retry-after=0.2
2026-03-22T11:02:12Z sdk retried req=rn-42 idempotency_key=none
2026-03-22T11:02:13Z server processed charge idempotency_key=none
```
mike: that's the classic token-rotate + immediate retry case. small product decisions: (1) sample apps: enable an opt-out auto-idempotency header for mutating calls, (2) SDKs: implement a short "replay guard" window that prevents immediate replay during token refresh, and (3) infra: accept a low-cardinality sample header so we can correlate a tiny fraction of throttled requests for debugging.
kevin: proposal for names: header for idempotency -> Idempotency-Key (standard). replay guard -> X-Rw-Replay-Guard: ts=1717778888;span=45s (servers only see a boolean/short span). sampling -> X-Rw-Sample-Tag: throttle-debug;v1 (send only when sampling triggered).
anna: implementation constraints: no payloads, no user identifiers, sampling only at retry-time, and default replay-guard should be conservative. I suggest default guard span = 45s for sample apps (configurable).
mike: SDK parity note: Node/Python/Go should all expose the same opt-out flags: {autoIdempotency: boolean, replayGuardMs: number, sampleThrottleRate: float}. sample app templates should demonstrate the flags.
kevin: streaming endpoints are special: do NOT enable auto-idempotency or aggressive replay-guard. add explicit opt-in for long-running or streaming flows with docs explaining risks.
anna: tiny sample snippet for sample apps:
```js
// mutating call in sample app
headers['Idempotency-Key'] = opts.idempotencyKey || uuidv4()
// if retry/backoff triggered
if (didThrottleOrRefresh) {
  headers['X-Rw-Replay-Guard'] = `span=45s`
  if (shouldSample()) headers['X-Rw-Sample-Tag'] = 'throttle-debug;v1'
}
await retryWithJitter({baseMs:250, maxMs:25000, honorRetryAfter:true})
```
mike: action items from thread: 1) devex: RFC proposing sample-app defaults + SDK config parity (assignee: @anna). 2) eng-runtime/infra: accept and index a boolean/sample tag for a short debug window and ensure pre-scrub / no PII (owner: @kevin). 3) SDK teams: add opt-out flags and snippet updates across repos. 4) docs: add explicit streaming exception and onboarding note.
ci-bot: created issue devex-900: "replay-guard + sample-tag RFC" (assignee: @anna) :spiral_note_pad:
kevin: one more: servers should treat absent idempotency header as "no guarantee". RFC should include compatibility plan for older SDKs.
anna: agreed. i'll draft RFC with considerations, default values, and a short test plan. thanks all. :thumbsup:
